meta.subject: Fix a bug where instruction retire perf events were counted when an instruction was rolled back

en.summary: Fixes retire-event generation so architecturally exposed performance counters do not count instructions that are rolled back instead of truly retired.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly describes a rollback-versus-retire hardware bug.
The patch changes writeback RTL that generates performance events consumed by the core performance-counter block.
The new condition preserves the special branch case that can redirect control while still legitimately retiring.
disqualifiers: The impact is on architecturally visible counter accuracy rather than the main execution datapath.
evidence: wb_perf_instruction_retire changed from any valid writeback-stage instruction to a condition additionally gated by !wb_rollback_en or a valid branch instruction.
The same always_ff block already arbitrates rollbacks and writeback, so this is the commit-point retirement signal rather than a test hook.
core.sv wires wb_perf_instruction_retire into perf_events, which are counted by performance_counters and exposed through control-register state.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a speculative pipeline, a late-stage instruction can be valid for writeback timing purposes even though the same cycle also triggers a rollback that squashes it. A retire performance event must therefore be qualified by real commit semantics, not just by pipeline validity. Otherwise the machine over-reports retired instructions, except in special cases such as branches that both retire and redirect control.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: An instruction reaches commit or writeback in a cycle where the core is also rolling back that thread or pipeline, excluding any architecturally valid redirect case that still counts as retired.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Count every valid late-stage instruction as retired without filtering out rollback cycles.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop rollback predicate from the retire counter event
portability_notes: This applies to designs with performance counters or trace events that claim to count retired instructions.
If the design has a documented exception such as retiring branches on redirects, preserve that exception in the fixed version and remove it for reinjection only if it existed in the buggy version.
The bug is still a DUT bug because software can observe the wrong count through control/status registers.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the signal that increments or emits the retired-instruction event at commit or writeback.
Remove the gating that suppresses the event when a rollback, squash, or flush is active for that instruction.
Leave the rest of the writeback datapath intact so only the retire accounting becomes optimistic.
If the implementation has a special-case retire-on-redirect path, collapse it back into the unconditional valid-based event.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes wb_perf_instruction_retire so it is suppressed on rollback cycles except when a valid branch instruction still legitimately retires.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore wb_perf_instruction_retire to the old unconditional valid check over fx5, ix, and dd instruction-valid signals.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Retired-instruction counters overcount on squashed or rolled-back instructions, especially during branch redirects, traps, or rollback-causing memory events.
evidence_for_injection: The patch only changes the retire-event predicate, not the counter block or tests.
The fix explicitly references wb_rollback_en, tying the event to commit semantics.
The signal feeds the core-wide perf_events bus, so the incorrect behavior is externally observable.
notes: This mutation targets observability correctness rather than arithmetic or control-flow correctness.
A good regression stimulus is a workload with frequent rollbacks and reads of the retire counter.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了退休事件生成逻辑，避免架构上可见的性能计数器把被回滚的指令也计为已退休指令。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确描述了“回滚”与“退休”判定混淆的硬件缺陷。
补丁修改的是 writeback RTL 中生成性能事件的逻辑，而这些事件会送入核心性能计数器模块。
新条件保留了分支这种“虽然重定向控制流但仍然合法退休”的特殊情况。
disqualifiers: 影响主要体现在架构可见的计数器准确性，而不是主执行数据通路。
evidence: wb_perf_instruction_retire 从“任一写回级有效指令都计数”变为还必须满足 !wb_rollback_en，或属于仍可合法退休的有效分支指令。
同一个 always_ff 块本身就在处理 rollback 与 writeback，因此这里是提交点语义，不是测试钩子。
core.sv 将 wb_perf_instruction_retire 接入 perf_events，再由 performance_counters 计数并通过控制寄存器状态对外暴露。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在带投机执行的流水线中，晚期流水级中的指令即使在时序上“有效”，同周期也可能因为 rollback 被真正冲刷掉。因此“退休性能事件”必须用真实提交语义来限定，而不能只看流水线 valid。否则机器会把并未真正提交的指令也统计为已退休；只有像分支这种既会重定向控制流又能合法退休的特例除外。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: rollback 条件下的退休事件限定
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某条指令到达提交或写回阶段时，同周期核心也在对该线程或该流水线执行 rollback；但不包括那些架构上仍算退休的重定向特例。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让所有晚期流水级有效指令都无条件产生 retired 事件，不再过滤 rollback 周期。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 从退休计数事件中删除 rollback 谓词
portability_notes: 适用于任何提供“已退休指令数”性能计数器或跟踪事件的设计。
如果设计中存在“重定向但仍退休”的明确特例，修复版应保留它；重注入时只在原始缺陷版本确实缺少过滤的情况下移除该限定。
之所以仍属于 DUT bug，是因为软件能通过控制/状态寄存器观察到错误计数。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到在 commit 或 writeback 处用于累加或发出 retired-instruction 事件的信号。
删除该事件在 rollback、squash 或 flush 活跃时的抑制条件。
保持其它写回数据通路不变，使错误只体现在退休统计过于乐观。
如果实现中对 redirect 指令做了特例处理，可把它重新并回“只看 valid”式的无条件事件。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: writeback_stage 中已退休指令性能事件的生成逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复让 wb_perf_instruction_retire 在 rollback 周期被抑制，只保留“有效分支仍可合法退休”的例外。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 wb_perf_instruction_retire 恢复成旧的无条件 valid 判定，即只看 fx5、ix、dd 三条路径的 instruction_valid。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 已退休指令计数器会在被 squash 或 rollback 的指令上过计数，尤其容易出现在分支重定向、trap 或引发 rollback 的访存事件中。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁只改了退休事件谓词，没有改计数器模块本身，也不是测试改动。
修复显式引用 wb_rollback_en，说明问题就在提交语义判定。
该信号最终送入核心级 perf_events 总线，因此错误行为对软件可见。
notes: 该变异针对的是可观察性正确性，而不是算术结果或控制流本身。
适合用高 rollback 频率的工作负载并读取 retire counter 来回归验证。
